provenance.source_title: I time travelled to Tudor London in 1536! (Vlog)

examples.psychological_goal: 第一秒即时兑现标题承诺，让观众确认'这趟穿越真的发生了'
examples.expression_mechanism: Okay, so + 现在完成时抵达断言 + 精确时空坐标，零铺垫
examples.example_text: Okay, so I have just arrived in Tudor London, 1536
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'Okay, so + 我已抵达[具体时空]'一句话兑现不可能承诺，不解释机制
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该时代与年份；开场断言必须是现在完成时的亲历声明

examples.psychological_goal: 在行程图末尾抛出高规格会面预告，为后段锁定长线悬念
examples.expression_mechanism: and then later I am meeting... 的顺手续约 + Yep 短确认句点名
examples.example_text: later I am meeting the actual king. Yep, Henry VIII in person.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把最大的会面预告当作行程清单的最后一项随手抛出，再用一个口语确认句加重
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该人物；预告对象必须是观众熟知的高知名度角色

examples.psychological_goal: 给落脚场景一个功能性定位，让观众用现代框架理解古代空间
examples.expression_mechanism: Whatever + 条件白描，再一句 this was the real X 定性
examples.example_text: this was the real news of Tudor London.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在场景白描后用一句'这才是真正的X'把空间升格为功能枢纽
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该城市名；定性句必须基于前文白描出的具体行为

examples.psychological_goal: 用起居不适的复读强调制造'难以置信的好笑'，完成身体穿越确认
examples.expression_mechanism: actual 复读强调 + 用下等生物的用途作比的降级类比
examples.example_text: So, the mattress is straw, actual straw, the stuff horses eat.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把不适细节复读一遍（actual X），再补一刀用途类比，让事实自己发笑
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该寝具与类比；复读强调一次到位，不可连用

examples.psychological_goal: 第一个肢体喜剧峰值：让观众在猝不及防中笑出声并加深陪伴感
examples.expression_mechanism: 全大写单句惊呼 + 被动语态播报体（I was just taken out by...）自嘲
examples.example_text: A PIG. I was just taken out by a Tudor pig in my new outfit.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习'全大写名词短句'先呈现冲击，再用被动播报体向观众复盘糗态
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该动物与事件；播报体必须紧跟在真实意外之后

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个具体小人物把'制度锁死人生'从抽象变为直视
examples.expression_mechanism: 年龄数字 + 现在完成时（已经开始了）+ this is his life now 的现在时判词
examples.example_text: That kid is about 10 years old, and he has already started his apprenticeship. Like, this is his life now.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'年龄+已开始的制度身份+现在时判词'三拍呈现底层人物的命运锁定
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该行业与年龄；沉重观察段落不使用俏皮语气

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个现代类比让观众瞬间理解古代信息中枢的权力意义
examples.expression_mechanism: basically the [现代物] 类比句 + how A, how B, how C 三连功能说明
examples.example_text: This right here is basically the internet. This is how news travels, how gossip spreads, how the king controls what people think.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先抛出大胆类比，再用三个 how 排比逐层把类比对接到传播与权力
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类比对象；类比必须在功能上严格成立而非形似

examples.psychological_goal: 全片基调拐点：让欢乐预期撞上残酷现场，再用双联判词完成认知翻转
examples.expression_mechanism: 短句揭示（It's a...）+ 制度判词（runs entirely on fear）+ But 转折的世俗化补充
examples.example_text: It's a public execution. The whole system of keeping order runs entirely on public fear. But, it is also just entertainment.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习'揭示短句→制度判词→世俗补充'的三拍暗面揭示结构，判词直白不加修饰
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该事件；揭示必须由前文的预期误导自然逼出

examples.psychological_goal: 用'骇人细节+熟视无睹的路人'的并置制造黑色着迷
examples.expression_mechanism: 方位白描 + 骇人名词 + and everyone just... every single day 的日常化对照
examples.example_text: At the top of this gatehouse, there are heads on spikes, and everyone just walks under them every single day.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把恐怖物象与日常行为写进同一句，用 just 和 every single day 制造日常化反差
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该地标与物象；骇人细节必须真实可考

examples.psychological_goal: 用一口气报菜单呈现选择的贫瘠，笑点与信息同步传达
examples.expression_mechanism: 名词连发报幕 + That is the entire menu 的极短判词落点
examples.example_text: Okay, so ale, pottage, pie, prip, bread. That is the entire menu.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用名词连发模拟报菜名节奏，再用一句极短判词盖章'就这些'
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该菜单；报幕项必须真实来自该场景

examples.psychological_goal: 食物评测第二次反转：点的与来的货不对板，用不确定语气放大喜感
examples.expression_mechanism: I ordered A. I got this + essentially 重新定义 + I think 的不确定收尾
examples.example_text: So, I ordered pie. I got this, which is essentially a very thick stew with some kind of meat in it, I think.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习'我点了A/我得到了这个'的对照开场，用 essentially 重命名实物，以 I think 留悬
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该菜品；评测反转必须基于真实的货不对板

examples.psychological_goal: 中点温情沉淀：让观众从看热闹转为对时代普通人的敬意
examples.expression_mechanism: so hard / so little 的双 so 对照 + still find a way 的转折 + just live 的单字落点
examples.example_text: These people, they work so hard and have so little and still find a way to just live.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'劳作那么苦/拥有那么少/仍想办法活'的对照排比给出温情判词
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该判词措辞；温情段落必须建立在前文具体见闻之上

examples.psychological_goal: 中点钩子：推翻观众对'此行目的'的既有假设，重开后半场悬念
examples.expression_mechanism: But + 具名人物 + is not the real reason 的否定式悬念句
examples.example_text: But Henry is not the real reason I'm going.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在中点用'但X并不是我去的真正原因'一句推翻预设，把长线悬念升级
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该人物；否定式钩子必须在后文给出真实目的

examples.psychological_goal: 用'保住脑袋'的双关把致命风险包装成笑料，再以宠粉自嘲收尾
examples.expression_mechanism: keeping my head firmly on my body 的字面化双关 + The things I do for... 的宠粉梗
examples.example_text: While also keeping my head firmly on my body. The things I do for my followers.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把真实的人身风险写成字面化双关，再接一句'我为粉丝才这样'的元吐槽
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该双关对象；双关必须同时成立字面义与时代义

examples.psychological_goal: 隐藏任务执行瞬间：用敬语+紧迫短句把警告塞进对手戏缝隙
examples.expression_mechanism: 敬语称呼 + need to + 时间状语从句（while you still can）的紧迫结构
examples.example_text: Your Majesty, you need to leave now while you still can.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在高压对手戏中用'敬语+立即行动+趁还来得及'的紧凑句传递警告
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该称呼与情境；紧迫句必须有前文铺垫的致命理由

examples.psychological_goal: 戏剧性反讽峰值：观众知道这是注定成真的预言，局中人不信
examples.expression_mechanism: 主语+将来时断言的极简预言句，不加任何解释与修饰
examples.example_text: Henry is going to betray you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把全片最重的一句信息压成最短断言，靠观众的历史知识完成反讽
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该人物与事件；极简预言成立的前提是观众已知结局

examples.psychological_goal: 礼仪焦虑的内心播报：让观众在'我也一样不会'的共鸣中发笑
examples.expression_mechanism: the X situation alone 的拟正式措辞 + I do not know what half of these are for 的老实自白
examples.example_text: The cutlery situation alone, I do not know what half of these are for.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用拟正式名词短语（X situation）包装慌乱，再接一句'一半都不认识'的老实话
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该餐具场景；焦虑播报必须落在具体的陌生物件上

examples.psychological_goal: 闹剧高潮的事后复盘：用递增的不确定性把出丑程度推向顶点
examples.expression_mechanism: In fairness 的拟正式开场 + 大词身份（the King of England）+ twice, possibly three times 的递增不确定
examples.example_text: In fairness, I did tread on the King of England's foot twice, possibly three times.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'公平地说+我确实踩了大人物的脚+两次可能三次'的递增复盘制造笑点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该人物与桥段；递增不确定必须基于真实发生的连续出丑

examples.psychological_goal: 总结判词：把对时代的最终定性从'地方'移到'人'身上，完成明暗合一
examples.expression_mechanism: but the people, 的转折+复读 + are what holds this place together 的拟物判词
examples.example_text: but the people, the people are what holds this place together.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'但是人，是人把这一切撑了起来'的复读强调判词收束对时代的评价
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该判词措辞；判词必须与前文的残酷清单形成明确转折

examples.psychological_goal: 以回归现代便利作为旅程落点，顺手完成与内容一致的订阅号召
examples.expression_mechanism: burning hot shower 的奢侈化修饰 + Oh, and if you want... 的随口 CTA
examples.example_text: burning hot shower. Oh, and if you want to see more videos like this, don't forget to hit that subscribe button.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把'回家洗个滚烫的热水澡'作为穿越叙事的情绪落点，再用 Oh, and 的随口语气接 CTA
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该便利物与 CTA 措辞；回归锚点必须是全片反复缺失的现代物
